title: Kyber Named as Finalist for Best Insurtech Team at the Global Insurtech Awards 2026
summary: Recognition highlights Kyber's team and its work advancing correspondence management for P&C insurers.
body_markdown:
‍ **NEW YORK, NY, November 6, 2026** – Kyber, an AI-native correspondence management platform built for property and casualty (P&C) insurers, has been named a finalist for **Best Insurtech Team** at the[Global Insurtech Awards 2026](https://www.globalinsurtechawards.com/2026shortlist) .


The recognition places Kyber alongside five other shortlisted companies: EIP, Majesco, Mind Your Business, Simfuni, and Vectoryx.


Following its participation in Y Combinator's startup accelerator program, Kyber has continued to expand its capabilities and reach, supporting P&C insurers across multiple lines of business in modernizing correspondence management.


Founded to address the manual work involved in insurance correspondence, Kyber has built a platform that connects claims data, document generation, template management, review and approval workflows, and delivery. Built-in governance and controls help insurers maintain oversight across the correspondence lifecycle.


Working closely with insurers, Kyber has helped claims teams reduce correspondence drafting time by 65% and achieve 5x faster letter cycles. The platform continues to evolve with expanded automation capabilities, enterprise governance, and deeper integrations with insurers' existing systems.


The finalist recognition is a milestone for the Kyber team and reflects the progress made alongside insurers and partners who continue to help shape the platform.


Kyber is proud to be recognized among this year's finalists and congratulates all the companies recognized at the Global Insurtech Awards 2026.


## About Kyber


Kyber is an AI-native correspondence management platform built for P&C insurers. By connecting claims data, document generation, template management, and correspondence workflows, Kyber helps insurers automate correspondence, reduce manual work, and manage communications with greater control.


Learn more at[www.askkyber.com](https://www.askkyber.com/) .
